title: Roamhaven Rewards Redemption Limits by Tier
content:
Roamhaven Rewards credits are redeemed against the stay's total price at booking. Each redemption on a booking falls between a fixed smallest amount and a per-booking maximum that rises with the member's tier.

| Tier | Smallest redemption (credits) | Most redeemed on one booking (credits) | Other members whose credits may be pooled |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rewards Member | 1.00 | 500.00 | 0 (not offered) |
| Rewards Silver | 1.00 | 1000.00 | 0 (not offered) |
| Rewards Gold | 1.00 | 1500.00 | 0 (not offered) |
| Rewards Platinum | 1.00 | 2500.00 | 2 |
| Rewards Diamond | 1.00 | 5000.00 | 4 |
| Rewards Ambassador | 1.00 | 10000.00 | 4 |

## What credits pay for (all tiers)

| Booking | Where credits apply |
|---|---|
| Any stay | The stay's total price at booking |
| Stay paid in monthly installments | Installment 1 only |

## Notes

- Household pooling is offered on Rewards Platinum (up to 2 other members), Rewards Diamond and Rewards Ambassador (up to 4 other members each). On Rewards Member, Rewards Silver and Rewards Gold the figure is 0: pooling is not offered.

## Hypothetical readings

| Member's tier | Credits the member wishes to apply to one booking | Within the tier's redemption figures? |
|---|---|---|
| Rewards Member | 500.00 | Yes, exactly at 500.00 |
| Rewards Member | 500.01 | No, above 500.00 |
| Rewards Gold | 0.50 | No, below the 1.00 smallest redemption |
| Rewards Platinum | 2500.00 | Yes, exactly at 2500.00 |
